# Golden Entry lines: kind|line|timestamp|text|author|source|device
# Parsed author/source are empty when the line holds a placeholder ([.] / (-)).
# canonical = format_entry(timestamp, text, author, source, device) must produce `line`.
# legacy    = older lines that must only parse.
# A copy lives in uvid-telegram-bot/tests/fixtures/entries.txt; keep them in step.
canonical|[29.09.2026 09:43:31] plain idea [.] (-) {laptop}|29.09.2026 09:43:31|plain idea|||laptop

canonical|[29.09.2026 09:43:31] idea (see chapter 3) [.] (-) {laptop}|29.09.2026 09:43:31|idea (see chapter 3)|||laptop
canonical|[29.09.2026 09:43:31] cite [1] here [Jane] (-) {laptop}|29.09.2026 09:43:31|cite [1] here|Jane||laptop

canonical|[29.09.2026 09:43:31] no device [.] (-)|29.09.2026 09:43:31|no device|||
